race.comment: SHELSTEIN (1) is back over the border after a freshen-up following a luckless sixth at Toowoomba nearly 7 weeks ago. He has Nash Rawiller in the irons, which is a positive lead for the Archibald stable, and over his pet trip, he can have a say in the finish of this race, especially if the track is wet. EASIEST CHOICE (9) ended her last campaign with a battling fifth on heavy ground at Kembla Grange. She resumes without any public trials, but comes to hand quickly, and is worth keeping safe in this. MONTE VEEBEE (6) was fifth and only 2 lengths from the winner in town at Randwick nearly a fortnight ago, and with JMac in the saddle for the first time, he will be hard to hold out from the pole position. ZOUCRATIC (8) will be chasing a hat-trick in a tougher grade here.
